symbols.read: Price slipped to 727.45 from 728.30, still holding above the 722.40 lower pivot, so the neutral-to-bullish bias stands and the SELL tag remains invalidated. The 1H trend is still up despite the last bar easing 728.01→726.85, and the bull FVG stack (708.95–724.26) is unchanged beneath price, keeping support intact. The 4H bearish direction and 758.44 upper pivot still frame this as a counter-trend bounce, not a reversal. Invalidation is unchanged: losing 722.40 into the FVG stack revives the bearish case toward the stale 686.36 target.
